title: The List of the Exiles

questions.question: Who came with Zerubbabel?
questions.explanation: Ezra 2:2 (ESV): "who came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai..."

questions.question: According to their ability, what did they give to the treasury?
options: 61,000 darics of gold, 5,000 minas of silver
questions.correctAnswer: 61,000 darics of gold, 5,000 minas of silver
questions.explanation: Ezra 2:69 (ESV): "...gave to the treasury... 61,000 darics of gold, 5,000 minas of silver..."

questions.question: What happened to those who could not prove their genealogy?
options: They were excluded from the priesthood as unclean
questions.correctAnswer: They were excluded from the priesthood as unclean
questions.explanation: Ezra 2:62 (ESV): "...so they were excluded from the priesthood as unclean."

questions.question: Where did the priests, Levites, and people live?
questions.explanation: Ezra 2:70 (ESV): "...lived in their towns, and all the rest of Israel in their towns."

questions.question: What did some of the heads of families do when they came to the house of the LORD?
questions.explanation: Ezra 2:68 (ESV): "...made freewill offerings for the house of God..."

questions.question: How many sons of Parosh were there?
Who were the singers?
questions.explanation: Ezra 2:41 (ESV): "The singers: the sons of Asaph, 128."

questions.question: How many temple servants and sons of Solomon's servants were there?
questions.explanation: Ezra 2:58 (ESV): "All the temple servants and the sons of Solomon's servants were 392."

questions.question: Who was the governor mentioned?
options: He is not named here, just referred to as "the governor"
questions.correctAnswer: He is not named here, just referred to as "the governor"
questions.explanation: Ezra 2:63 (ESV): "The governor told them that they were not to partake of the most holy food..." (It is widely thought to be Sheshbazzar or Zerubbabel)

questions.question: What was the whole assembly count?
How many servants and maidservants were generally with them?
questions.explanation: Ezra 2:65 (ESV): "besides their male and female servants, of whom there were 7,337..."

questions.question: How many singers (male and female) were with them?
questions.explanation: Ezra 2:65 (ESV): "...and they had 200 male and female singers."

questions.question: Until when were the excluded priests told not to partake of the most holy food?
options: Until there should be a priest to consult Urim and Thummim
questions.correctAnswer: Until there should be a priest to consult Urim and Thummim
questions.explanation: Ezra 2:63 (ESV): "...until there should be a priest to consult Urim and Thummim."

key_verse_text: Some of the heads of families, when they came to the house of the LORD that is in Jerusalem, made freewill offerings for the house of God, to erect it on its site.
